name: data-engineering
description: Project-local managed-coworker that authors terse data models + enums as the chassis grows. Sits across AlloyDB (persistence) + Redis (task queues) + Cloudflare (visualization + Workers Analytics Engine). OAuth-only, connector-enum like its sibling product-management. One-ticket-one-PR discipline enforced via Atlassian integration.

datastores.title: Datastore connector(s)
datastores.description: Which datastore MCP server(s) to enable. Defaults to the chassis's existing alloydb + redis from root .mcp.json. Operator may add additional stores (e.g. turbopuffer for vectors, neon for branched Postgres).

ticketing.title: Project-management connector
ticketing.description: Ticketing MCP server for the 1-ticket-1-PR discipline (Atlassian / GitHub Projects / Linear). Operator-authorized.

viz.title: Visualization surface
viz.description: Visualization MCP server(s) for rendering the data architecture diagram. Defaults to cloudflare-codemode for Workers-rendered HTML/SVG; chrome-devtools for snapshot validation.

domain_models_path.title: Domain models output directory
domain_models_path.description: Where this coworker writes terse data-model + enum TypeScript files (one file per domain). Defaults to src/domain/models/.
